title: The last Soldier (TLS)
description: This mod adds rats, bugs, jellybears and bosses to the game
body:
**Greetings again!**

[MY LINK](https://gogosweb.carrd.co/)

I'm back with another mod, and it's called The Last Soldier, or **TLS** for short. To put it briefly, and I'll explain in detail later, it adds **bugs, mice, bosses, and gummy bears**. Unfortunately, this is only the first version, and there may be some bugs. Please report them and help me find them. But don't worry, everything will be updated and fixed in the next version!

Let's start with the mobs. Our newest creatures, **worms**, are small, but I wanted to call them "worms." They don't do much damage, but they slowly attack you and give you a _dead worm_. If you eat them, you'll be poisoned and spawn a new worm. Isn't that cool?

Our next creature is a **butterfly**. Unfortunately, its texture and model are a bit bad (for now), but that will be fixed. When you kill it, it gives you a _dead butterfly_, and you can't do anything with it...

Let's move on. Our next creature is a **mouse**. There are two variations of these mice: one gray and one brown. They spawn in the **cheese world biome**. They attack you and are quite fast. Killing them has a 40 percent chance of giving you a _dead mouse_, and eating them will poison you they drop _yeast_ too you can use them to craft cheese!

The next creature is a **fly** or **mosquito** ı dont know how you call it it dosent do anything special its just a **fly**...

And my favorite creatures are **ants**! Yes, you heard right, ants can spawn anywhere in nature and with its cute animation it tricks you and bites you. It can also defend you. If you take the dagger that falls from the boss and right click on it, you can get a blue-eyed version of it that you can ride and that doesn't attack you. Ants drop _dead ants_ and this is useless...

Let's get to the **bosses**. Our first boss is the **butterfly king**. I know it sounds weird but it is a huge boss that comes in the pupa stage. When you kill it, it gives you a weapon called _dagger_. When you right click it, you summon a friendly ant and it has 9 attack damage. To spawn this boss, you need to find a butterfly king egg and right click on it. Also, these eggs are usually found near the leaves. 

Another one of our bosses is the **humanist rat**. I know it sounds weird but this boss is nothing more than a mouse with a cool sword that stands on two legs. You can spawn it by right-clicking on the cheese block in its structure or you can craft this block with 9 cheeses. When you kill it, it drops a sword that shoots lightning on every damage and when you right-click it, it shoots lightning.
